docs.title: SageBase Data Model
docs.text: SageBase is a data model for the SageBRUSH platform managed by the Conservation Technology Lab at San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: See the Data Model Overview for a full entity-relationship diagram.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
A minimal implementation contains one CSV per primary table plus a data.json descriptor:

survey/
├── site.csv
├── deployment.csv
├── event.csv
├── occurrence.csv
├── sensor_measure.csv
